news.title: Blue Chip India Limited to Report Q3, 2026 Results on Feb 12, 2026
news.body: Blue Chip India Limited announced that they will report Q3, 2026 results on Feb 12, 2026

news.title: Blue Chip India Ltd Appoints Asha Pal as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, Effective January 5, 2026
news.body: Blue Chip India Ltd. appointed Mrs. Asha Pal as the Company Secretary and Compliance Officer of the Company. The appointment is effective from January 5, 2026. Asha Pal is an Associate member of Institute of Company Secretaries of India (Membership No. A58325) having experience in compliance and governance management. A well accredited Company Secretary and a Management Expert, she is highly specialized in Companies Act, the Securities and Exchange Board of India Act. The board meeting to approve this appointment was held on January 5, 2026.

news.title: Blue Chip India Ltd Announces Resignation of Soni Jain as Chief Financial Officer, Effective December 23, 2025
news.body: Blue Chip India Ltd. announced that Ms. Soni Jain, Chief Financial Officer and Key Managerial Personnel of the Company, has tendered her resignation from the services of the Company to pursue another career opportunity. The effective date of cessation is December 23, 2025.

news.title: Blue Chip India Ltd Announces Board Changes, Effective December 23, 2025
news.body: Blue Chip India Ltd. accepted the resignation of Mr. Shyamal Banerjee as an Independent Director of the Company with effect from December 23, 2025. Mr. Shyamal Banerjee holds directorship in Alkon Trading Limited. Blue Chip India Ltd. accepted the resignation of Mr. Sahil Sharma as an Independent Director of the Company with effect from December 23, 2025. Mr. Sahil Sharma holds directorship in Silicon Valley Infotech Limited and is a member of the Audit Committee and Stakeholders Committee. Blue Chip India Ltd. appointed Mr. Manas Ranjan Palo as an Additional Director (Non-Executive-Independent) of the Company with effect from December 23, 2025 for a term of 5 years. news.title: New major risk - Financial position
news.body: The company has less than a year of cash runway based on its current free cash flow trend. Free cash flow: -₹3.5m This is considered a major risk. With less than a year's worth of cash, the company will need to raise capital or take on debt unless its cash flows improve. This would dilute existing shareholders or increase balance sheet risk. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risks Less than 1 year of cash runway based on free cash flow trend (-₹3.5m free cash flow). Shares are highly illiquid. Negative equity (-₹6.7m). Earnings have declined by 44% per year over the past 5 years. Revenue is less than US$1m (₹868k revenue, or US$9.8k). Market cap is less than US$10m (₹192.5m market cap, or US$2.17m).
